title.en: OpenAI’s Sam Altman Says It Would Be ‘Ill-Advised’ to Go Public in 2026
title.zh-TW: OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 表示 2026 年上市「不智」

summary.en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated that an IPO in 2026 would be ill-advised during a Fortune interview. The company has filed confidentially for an IPO but will not go public this year. Altman also discussed the Hugging Face hacking incident, recursive self-improvement, and risks of AI beyond human control, vowing to pause training if needed.
summary.zh-TW: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 在 Fortune 訪談中表示，2026 年 IPO 將是不智之舉。公司已機密提交 IPO 申請，但今年不會上市。Altman 還討論了 Hugging Face 駭客事件、遞迴自我改進，以及超越人類控制的 AI 風險，並誓言必要時暫停訓練。

body.en:
Lede: OpenAI’s Sam Altman says it would be ‘ill-advised’ to go public in 2026.

What happened: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman confirmed during an interview with Fortune that there would be no OpenAI IPO in 2026. While OpenAI has filed confidentially for an IPO, the company will not be going public this year, according to CEO Sam Altman. Over the course of 45 minutes, Altman discussed a variety of subjects including the Hugging Face hacking incident, recursive self-improvement, and the possibility of building an AI that was beyond human control. On the latter, he said it was "absolutely" possible, but vowed to take actions to prevent that from happening, even if it meant pausing training.

Why it matters: The statements clarify OpenAI’s near-term plans regarding public markets and highlight ongoing internal considerations around advanced AI development.

Sources agree/disagree: Both sources report the same core statement from Altman on the 2026 IPO timeline and the confidential filing.

Still uncertain: The full context of the interview remarks on AI risks remains partially detailed in available reports.
body.zh-TW:
Lede: OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 表示 2026 年上市將是「不智」之舉。

What happened: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 在 Fortune 訪談中確認，2026 年不會有 OpenAI IPO。雖然 OpenAI 已機密提交 IPO 申請，但根據執行長 Sam Altman 表示，公司今年不會上市。在 45 分鐘的訪談中，Altman 討論了多個主題，包括 Hugging Face 駭客事件、遞迴自我改進，以及建構超越人類控制 AI 的可能性。關於後者，他表示「絕對」可能，但誓言將採取行動防止發生，即使意味著暫停訓練。

Why it matters: 這些聲明澄清了 OpenAI 近期公開市場計畫，並突顯先進 AI 發展的內部考量。

Sources agree/disagree: 兩來源均報導 Altman 對 2026 年 IPO 時間表及機密申請的相同核心陳述。

Still uncertain: 訪談中關於 AI 風險的完整語境在現有報導中仍部分詳細。

body.en:
Lede: Virgo Transport 8 ferry capsized in the Java Sea, resulting in six deaths and over one hundred missing.

What happened: The ship encountered bad weather and overturned. Indonesian authorities intensified searches on Monday for those missing after the ferry capsized in the Java Sea. Ships and helicopters are searching for survivors from the Virgo Transport 8.

Why it matters: The incident highlights risks of sea travel in adverse conditions and the scale of ongoing rescue efforts in Indonesian waters.

Sources agree/disagree: Both sources confirm at least six deaths and bad weather as the cause, with search operations active.

Still uncertain: Exact number of missing persons and full details on rescue outcomes remain unclear.

導言：維爾戈運輸8號渡輪在爪哇海傾覆，造成六人死亡及逾百人失蹤。

事件經過：該船遭遇惡劣天氣並翻覆。印尼當局週一加強搜尋爪哇海渡輪傾覆後失蹤人員。船隻與直升機正搜尋維爾戈運輸8號的倖存者。

body.en:
Lede: MIT researchers have developed a new technique that helps generative artificial intelligence models find solutions to high-stakes problems.

What happened: MIT researchers have developed a new technique that helps generative artificial intelligence models find solutions to high-stakes problems. In these settings, a plausible answer is not enough: The output often must also satisfy nonnegotiable safety, physical, or task-specific requirements, known as hard constraints. The researchers developed a method that helps generative models meet these strict requirements without sacrificing the quality of their outputs. The key to their technique is to give. Source: https://news.mit.edu/2026/new-method-enables-ai-safety-critical-situations-0914

Why it matters: In these settings, a plausible answer is not enough: The output often must also satisfy nonnegotiable safety, physical, or task-specific requirements, known as hard constraints.

summary.zh-TW: 根據雅虎財經報導，2026年9月14日比特幣與以太幣價格試圖維持穩定，而白銀下滑，因升息預期增加。文章將加密貨幣韌性與貴金屬下跌直接連結至貨幣政策展望變化。

body.en:
Lede: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and silver prices faced market pressures on Monday, September 14, 2026, tied to rising rate-hike expectations.

What happened: Yahoo Finance reported Bitcoin and Ethereum prices trying to hold amid these expectations. A separate report noted silver prices sliding under the same conditions.

Why it matters: These movements highlight how anticipated interest rate changes influence both cryptocurrency and precious metals markets.

Sources agree/disagree: Both sources from Yahoo Finance align on the role of rate-hike expectations as a key factor on this date.

Still uncertain: No additional details on exact price levels or further market reactions are provided in the source titles.

title.zh-TW: Raghad Albakheet 與 Danial Salman 在學生奧斯卡獎提名短片後開發首部長片

summary.en: Jordanian filmmakers Raghad Albakheet and Danial Salman are developing separate feature projects after their short film A Subconscious Dive reached the Student Academy Award semifinalist shortlist in the Alternative/Experimental category. Directed by Albakheet and produced by Salman, the film is only the second Jordanian entry in the awards history.
summary.zh-TW: 約旦電影人 Raghad Albakheet 與 Danial Salman 在短片《A Subconscious Dive》入圍學生奧斯卡獎另類/實驗類別半決賽後，正分別開發首部長片作品。該片由 Albakheet 執導、Salman 監製，是約旦史上第二部入圍此獎的影片。

body.en:
Lede: Jordanian filmmakers Raghad Albakheet and Danial Salman are following up the success of their Student Academy Award-nominated short film A Subconscious Dive with separate feature projects.

What happened: Directed by Albakheet and produced by Salman, A Subconscious Dive made the short list of semifinalists in the Alternative/Experimental category.

Why it matters: The achievement marks the film as only the second Jordanian film in history to reach this stage.

Sources agree/disagree: With only one source available, there are no conflicting reports on names, categories, or achievements.

Still uncertain: Details on the new feature film titles, plots, or timelines are not provided in the source. Read the full article at https://variety.com/2026/film/global/student-academy-awards-a-subconscious-dive-jordan-1236853210/
body.zh-TW:

title.zh-TW: 【限制級】AV 女優桜井みなみ宣布暫停拍片一年，轉戰品牌與 Fanbox
title.en: [Adult 18+] AV actress Minami Sakurai pauses filming for a year for brand deals and Fanbox

summary.zh-TW: （18+）成年表演者桜井みなみ（Minami Sakurai，示範藝名）將暫別新作檔期，改經營個人品牌、寫真週邊與 pixivFANBOX 訂閱；業界稱屬後專屬約常見轉型。
summary.en: (18+) Adult performer Minami Sakurai (demo stage name) will pause new shoots to run a personal brand, photobook merch and pixivFANBOX subscriptions; trade voices call it a common post-exclusive shift.

disagreements.zh-TW: 粉絲媒體強調「告別感」；產業媒體則視為商業模式升級，未必等於退役。
disagreements.en: Fan media lean into farewell vibes; trade press frames it as a business-model upgrade, not necessarily retirement.

body.zh-TW:
（限制級／成人產業新聞）人氣 AV 女優桜井みなみ（Minami Sakurai）——示範用成年表演者藝名——經事務所證實將暫停拍片約一年，期間重心改為個人保養／時尚聯名、寫真週邊，以及 pixivFANBOX 等粉絲訂閱平台。同業評論指這是專屬約結束後常見的「品牌化」路徑；粉絲則出現支持轉型與希望回歸作品的兩極留言。本卡僅在使用者選擇加入成人區後顯示。

具名到藝名與平台，是為了讓產業動態可追蹤，而非使用「某人氣女優」空泛主詞。內容僅討論合法成年表演者的事業選擇與商業模式，不含任何未成年相關描述。

娛樂產業稿偏寫粉絲情緒；產業稿寫訂閱分成與品牌授權。暫停檔期與轉訂閱這兩點，事務所聲明與媒體報導大致吻合。

後續仍取決於本人是否延長休片，以及聯名產品是否如期上市。
body.en:
(Adult 18+ / industry news) Popular AV actress Minami Sakurai (桜井みなみ)—a demo adult stage name—will pause filming for about a year, per her agency, to focus on beauty/fashion brand deals, photobook merch and fan subscriptions such as pixivFANBOX. Trade commentators call this a common post-exclusive “branding” path; fans split between supporting the pivot and wanting her back on set. This card shows only after adult-zone opt-in.

Naming the performer and platforms makes the beat trackable instead of a vague “popular actress.” Coverage discusses lawful adult performers’ career and business choices only—no content involving minors.

Entertainment copy leans fan emotion; trade copy covers subscription splits and licensing. The pause and the subscription shift align across the agency note and press.

Open questions: whether she extends the hiatus, and whether collab products ship on time.

title.zh-TW: 【限制級】OnlyFans 與 Fansly 收緊預覽分級：露骨畫面須遮罩
title.en: [Adult 18+] OnlyFans and Fansly tighten preview ratings: explicit frames must be masked

summary.zh-TW: （18+）OnlyFans、Fansly 等成人向訂閱平台更新守則：公開預覽禁止未遮罩露骨畫面，完整內容仍限成年驗證帳號；創作者擔憂曝光，平台稱配合應用商店審核。
summary.en: (18+) OnlyFans, Fansly and peer adult subscription platforms updated rules: public previews cannot show unmasked explicit frames; full posts stay behind age-verified accounts. Creators fear reach loss; platforms cite app-store and ad review.

disagreements.zh-TW: 平台強調「仍可發完整成人內容」；創作者認為預覽遮罩等於實質降流。
disagreements.en: Platforms stress full adult content remains allowed; creators say masked previews amount to a de facto reach cut.

body.zh-TW:
（限制級／平台政策）主流成人訂閱平台 OnlyFans 與競品 Fansly 更新社群與預覽守則：公開動態與商店預覽頁不得出現未遮罩的露骨性畫面，完整內容仍僅對完成成年驗證的訂閱者開放。部分短影音分發渠道同步跟進。成人創作者擔心發現頁流量下滑；平台公關強調是為通過應用商店與支付／廣告審核的合規要求。僅限成人區顯示。

點名 OnlyFans、Fansly，避免「主流訂閱平台」的模糊主詞；正文解釋它們是面向成年創作者的訂閱服務。政策爭議的核心是「可發現性 vs 商店合規」，不是內容合法性本身。

創作者權益媒體與平台聲明立場對立，但「規則已改、預覽須遮罩」的事實層一致。

執行力度與是否影響既有貼文回溯處理，仍待各平台說明頁更新。
body.en:
(Adult 18+ / platform policy) Major adult subscription platforms OnlyFans and rival Fansly updated feed and preview rules: public posts and store previews may not show unmasked explicit sexual imagery; full content remains limited to age-verified subscribers. Some short-video distribution channels followed. Adult creators worry about discovery reach; platform spokespeople cite app-store, payments and ad-review compliance. Adult-zone only.

Naming OnlyFans and Fansly avoids a vague “major platforms” subject; the body explains they are subscription services for adult creators. The policy fight is discoverability versus store compliance—not legality of adult content itself.

Creator-advocacy media and platform statements clash on tone; the fact layer—“rules changed, previews need masks”—aligns.

Enforcement strength and whether old posts are retroactively processed still await help-center updates.
